en: Antique hand‑colored multi‑view postcard with floral decorations, showing four small images: a school building labeled "Schule", a manor or castle front labeled "Schloss", an inner castle courtyard labeled "Schlosshof", and a village square with a chapel labeled "Ortsplatz m. d. Kapelle." In the center is the caption "Gruss aus Enzowann." The border is ornate with pink flowers, and there is printing information along the bottom edge.
